headline: Towhid Hridoy to captain Bangladesh T20 squad for Zimbabwe tour
summary: The BCB has announced a 15-member squad for the three-match T20 series, with Hridoy leading in the absence of Litton Das.
details: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) has announced a 15-member squad for the upcoming three-match T20 series in Zimbabwe.
In the absence of regular captain Litton Das, Towhid Hridoy will lead the side for the first time in T20s.
The squad includes the return of Mosaddek Hossain Sobhan and Yasir Ali Chowdhury, while Soumya Sarkar and Shamim Hossain Patwari have been dropped.

The full squad consists of Towhid Hridoy (C), Parvez Hossain Emon, Tanzid Hasan, Mohammad Saif Hassan, Mosaddek Hossain Sobhan, Yasir Ali Chowdhury, Kazi Nurul Hasan Sohan, Sheikh Mahmudi Hasan, Nasum Ahmed, Rishad Hossain, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman, Nahid Rana, Mohammad Saifuddin and Abdul Ghaffar Salehian.
All three T20 matches will be played at the Queens Sports Club in Bulawayo.
The series begins on July 15 with the first T20, followed by the second on July 17 and the third on July 19.
Each match will start at 4:30 PM Bangladesh time.
caption:
A new leader emerges! Towhid Hridoy takes the captaincy for the Zimbabwe tour.

The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) has announced a 15-member squad for the upcoming three-match T20 series in Zimbabwe.

In the absence of regular captain Litton Das, Towhid Hridoy will lead the side for the first time in T20s.

The squad includes the return of Mosaddek Hossain Sobhan and Yasir Ali Chowdhury, while Soumya Sarkar and Shamim Hossain Patwari have been dropped.

The full squad consists of Towhid Hridoy (C), Parvez Hossain Emon, Tanzid Hasan, Mohammad Saif Hassan, Mosaddek Hossain Sobhan, Yasir Ali Chowdhury, Kazi Nurul Hasan Sohan, Sheikh Mahmudi Hasan, Nasum Ahmed, Rishad Hossain, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman, Nahid Rana, Mohammad Saifuddin and Abdul Ghaffar Salehian.

All three T20 matches will be played at the Queens Sports Club in Bulawayo.

The series begins on July 15 with the first T20, followed by the second on July 17 and the third on July 19.

Each match will start at 4:30 PM Bangladesh time.

headline: Record $35.56 billion remittance inflows hit new high in FY26
summary: Bangladesh saw a 17.30% year-on-year increase in money sent home by expats, helping the country manage external accounts amid declining exports.
details: Remittance inflows reached a record high of $35.56 billion in the 2025-26 fiscal year, according to provisional data from Bangladesh Bank.
This represents a 17.30% increase compared to the $30.3 billion recorded in the previous fiscal year.
The surge in funds sent home by Bangladeshis abroad has helped the country better manage its external accounts during a period of declining exports.
Despite the record total, the growth rate slowed to 17.30% from the 27% increase recorded in the previous year.
Bangladesh Bank noted that these figures are provisional as data from 11 banks has not yet been received due to a bank holiday.
caption:
A new record! 🇧🇩 Bangladesh hit $35.56 billion in remittance inflows for FY26.

Remittance inflows reached a record high of $35.56 billion in the 2025-26 fiscal year, according to provisional data from Bangladesh Bank.

This represents a 17.30% increase compared to the $30.3 billion recorded in the previous fiscal year.

The surge in funds sent home by Bangladeshis abroad has helped the country better manage its external accounts during a period of declining exports.

Despite the record total, the growth rate slowed to 17.30% from the 27% increase recorded in the previous year.

Bangladesh Bank noted that these figures are provisional as data from 11 banks has not yet been received due to a bank holiday.
